in_sanskrit.name: Vikesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है powerful, brave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vikesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vikesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vikram', which means 'to conquer' or 'to be powerful'. The name is also associated with bravery and strength. In Hindu mythology, there is a god named Vishveshvara, which means 'lord of the universe'. The name Vikesh can be considered as a modern representation of this powerful and divine name.
